quantity.title: Quantity
quantity.description: Whole units only. Typing 1.9 must not silently become 1.

palletCount.title: Pallets
palletCount.description: Shipped in pairs, so valid values are 2, 4, 6 ... 40.

weightKg.title: Weight (kg)
weightKg.description: Must be greater than zero, never exactly zero.

discountPercent.title: Discount
discountPercent.description: Rendered as a slider; the range tester needs minimum, maximum and default.

toleranceMm.title: Tolerance (mm)
toleranceMm.description: Negative values are ordinary data, not an empty field.
